event_id.description:
The event's ID, the same on every delivery of it and the
`webhook-id` header's value.

link.description: Where a person acts on it, such as the Run's page, if anywhere.

product.description: The Product whose engine sent it.

run_id.description: The Run it concerns, if any.

schedule_id.description: The Schedule it concerns, if any.

anyOf.description: The whole Notification, a channel's `webhook.payload` of `full`.
Its IDs and link only, a channel's `webhook.payload` of `thin`.

NotificationEvent.description: A Notification event's `snake_case` name: one of Collie's, or another Product's or a newer engine's, which a reader keeps as received.

oneOf.description: A Run started.
A Run finished.
A Run ended on an error.
A Run was stopped, by a Limit, a person or a program.
A Run's success check rejected its result.
A Run's result waits for a person's review.
A Run ended with its Completeness `incomplete`.
A Run reported an Effect whose outcome is uncertain.
A person is asked to reconcile an uncertain Effect.
An uncertain Effect was reconciled.
A Run waits for a person's approval.
A Human pause waits for a person, with a link to the Live view.
A Limit reached its warning threshold.
A Schedule paused itself.
A Limit skipped a Schedule's occurrences, notified once per period.
A Schedule's occurrences were missed, notified once per wake.
A Saved identity's earliest cookie expiry entered its warning window.
Code mode or a Plugin was quarantined.

NotificationPayload.description:
A `webhook` channel's delivery: the Standard Webhooks envelope around
one Notification.

data.description:
The Notification, whole or thin as the channel's `webhook.payload`
says.

format.description:
The body's `major.minor` version: a receiver reads every minor of
its major.

timestamp.description: When the Notification's event happened, in RFC 3339, UTC.

type.description:
`notification.` and the Notification's event, such as
`notification.run_failed`.

PointInTime.description: A point in time in UTC, as RFC 3339.

Product.description:
One of Goodfetch's two Products (ADR 0084), by its mark as the catalog
writes it.

oneOf.description: Browser automation; Foxhound contains it.
Crawling, which contains Collie.

RunId.description: A Run ID (ADR 0036): lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting and ending with a letter or a digit, never a name Windows reserves for a device.

ScheduleId.description: A Schedule ID (ADR 0036): lowercase letters, digits and `-`, at most 63, starting and ending with a letter or a digit.

ThinNotification.description:
A thin Notification: its IDs and link only, which an Integration reads
the rest from.

The event's ID, the same on every delivery of it and the
`webhook-id` header's value.

link.description: Where a person acts on it, such as the Run's page, if anywhere.

run_id.description: The Run it concerns, if any.

schedule_id.description: The Schedule it concerns, if any.
